_about: 3-31 (R1 fix 1): antiportal_2436 (scale 5, 160 px at 32 x scale) holds the keyhole, the yellow door
and the exit room, and its agent sits inside crate_2355; the keyhole also lies inside
shock_agent_ent_2441's 94 px ring. Every portal before the agent dies is 199 px or more from the
ring's centre. A portal on the gutter block at (384, 118) and one on the player:
fire_diamond_ent_2199 is taken. From the lower platform's left edge three taps become fireballs
(tick 190, 270, 360): the first destroys the shock agent and its ring, the second burns the crate,
the third burns knight B, whose key drops on the left platform. Right under the gutter block (the
port's 44 px body squeezes through its 42 px pocket; the original's mage, dark_mage.ent's compound,
is 36.2 tall): the diamond is drained (514) and taps open portals again. A portal by the key and one
on the player: the key is taken (577). Right to the ledge's end, a portal over the single block at
(392, 340) and one on the player; from the block a shot at (224, 456) passes
anti_portal_agent_ent_2430, now bare, and kills it and its ring (727). A portal by the keyhole at
(195, 450) and one on the player: the key opens it (765) and the yellow door goes (851); left into
the door. Won on tick 886. Leans on G1 (the knight never sees or shoots), G10 and G4.
